name: Olomouc
tagline: Moravia's historic university city, a baroque square crowned by Central Europe's tallest sculpture and a clock rebuilt in unmistakable socialist-realist style.
highlight: Standing beneath the Holy Trinity Column at dusk, floodlights picking out four decades of baroque sculpture stacked 35 metres into the sky.
shortDescription: Moravia's historic university city, home to the UNESCO-listed Holy Trinity Column, a striking socialist-realist astronomical clock and its own pungent cheese.
metaDescription: An Olomouc travel guide: the Holy Trinity Column, the Astronomical Clock, St Wenceslas Cathedral, food and how to plan a visit to Moravia's historic city.
nearestAirport: Brno–Tuřany Airport (BRQ) or Ostrava Leoš Janáček Airport (OSR), each about 1-1.5 hours by road
knownFor: The Holy Trinity Column, the Astronomical Clock, Olomoucké tvarůžky cheese
budget: Kč1,800–3,500 per day, budget to mid-range

image.alt: The Holy Trinity Column on Olomouc's Upper Square

intro: Olomouc is genuinely Moravia's other great historic city, a compact university town whose old town rivals Prague's for architecture while receiving a fraction of the visitors.
Its centrepiece is genuinely the Holy Trinity Column, a UNESCO-listed baroque sculpture the tallest of its kind anywhere in Central Europe.

The city is also genuinely home to one of the country's most unusual astronomical clocks, rebuilt after the war in bold socialist-realist style, and to Olomoucké tvarůžky, a pungent local cheese found nowhere else.

whyVisit.intro: Olomouc's case rests genuinely on remarkable baroque architecture paired with a lively, youthful university city atmosphere.

points.title: The Holy Trinity Column is genuinely Central Europe's tallest baroque sculpture
points.text: A UNESCO World Heritage Site standing 35 metres above the main square.

points.title: The Astronomical Clock is genuinely unlike any other in the country
points.text: Rebuilt in striking socialist-realist mosaic style after wartime damage.

points.title: The old town is genuinely one of the country's best-preserved
points.text: Baroque squares and six ornate fountains, with far fewer crowds than Prague.

points.title: It's genuinely home to a unique local cheese
points.text: Olomoucké tvarůžky, a pungent speciality made nowhere else in the world.

points.title: It's genuinely a lively university city
points.text: A large student population keeps Olomouc's café and bar scene genuinely buzzing.

attractionsIntro: Olomouc's essential sights are genuinely concentrated around its baroque Upper and Lower Squares.

attractions.name: The Holy Trinity Column

image.alt: The Holy Trinity Column on Olomouc's Upper Square

attractions.text: Genuinely the tallest baroque sculptural column in Central Europe, and a UNESCO World Heritage Site in its own right.
attractions.tip: Genuinely visit at dusk, when floodlighting brings out the sculpture's full detail.

attractions.name: The Olomouc Astronomical Clock

image.alt: Olomouc's Astronomical Clock with its socialist-realist mosaic

attractions.text: Genuinely unlike any other clock in the country, rebuilt after wartime damage in bold socialist-realist mosaic style depicting workers rather than saints.
attractions.tip: Genuinely a fascinating contrast to Prague's medieval version — worth seeking out specifically for that reason.

attractions.name: St Wenceslas Cathedral

image.alt: St Wenceslas Cathedral in Olomouc

attractions.text: Genuinely a soaring neo-Gothic cathedral with the second-tallest church tower in the country.
attractions.tip: Genuinely combine with a stroll through the adjacent Přemyslid Palace grounds.

attractions.name: Horní náměstí (Upper Square) and Town Hall

image.file: File:Olomouc - Horní Náměšti - Hercules Fountain & Town Hall 01.jpg
image.alt: Olomouc's Upper Square and Town Hall

attractions.text: Genuinely the city's grand baroque heart, its ornate town hall and column ringed by colourful facades.
attractions.tip: Genuinely arrive at the top of the hour to see the Astronomical Clock's figures in motion.

attractions.name: The Caesar Fountain

image.file: File:Olomouc - Horní náměstí - Caesarova kašna - Caesar Fountain 1725 by Václav Render & Jan Jiří Schauberger.jpg
image.alt: The Caesar Fountain on Olomouc's Upper Square

attractions.text: Genuinely the grandest of the city's six baroque fountains, depicting Julius Caesar on horseback.
attractions.tip: Genuinely try to spot all six fountains scattered across the old town during your visit.

attractions.name: The Archbishop's Palace

image.alt: The Archbishop's Palace in Olomouc

attractions.text: Genuinely a grand baroque palace that has hosted European royalty, including a young Emperor Franz Joseph's coronation confirmation.
attractions.tip: Genuinely tour the ornate interior for a look at Olomouc's ecclesiastical history.

attractions.name: Olomouc's historic squares

image.alt: Olomouc's historic Upper Square

attractions.text: Genuinely worth simply wandering, a near-complete baroque townscape with far fewer visitors than Prague's equivalent streets.
attractions.tip: Genuinely explore both the Upper and Lower Squares to see the full scope of the old town.

thingsToDoIntro: Olomouc genuinely rewards a relaxed pace, its baroque squares, fountains and cafés built for unhurried wandering.

thingsToDo.title: Marvel at the Holy Trinity Column

image.alt: The Holy Trinity Column in Olomouc

thingsToDo.text: A genuinely essential stop, taking in the sculpture's scale and detail from every angle.
thingsToDo.tip: Genuinely check inside the column's small chapel, open on select days.

thingsToDo.title: Watch the Astronomical Clock's figures in motion

image.alt: Detail of Olomouc's Astronomical Clock

thingsToDo.text: A genuinely quirky spectacle, mosaic figures of workers and athletes marking the hour instead of saints.
thingsToDo.tip: Genuinely arrive a few minutes before the hour for the best view of the moving figures.

thingsToDo.title: Tour St Wenceslas Cathedral

image.file: File:Olomouc - 1. máje - View ENE towards St Wenceslas Cathedral.jpg
image.alt: St Wenceslas Cathedral in Olomouc

thingsToDo.text: A genuinely rewarding visit, taking in the cathedral's soaring neo-Gothic nave and treasury.
thingsToDo.tip: Genuinely climb the tower if it's open for one of the city's best views.

thingsToDo.title: Fountain-hop around the old town

image.file: File:Olomouc - Corner Horní náměstí - Ostružnická - View on Caesar Fountain 01.jpg
image.alt: One of Olomouc's baroque fountains

thingsToDo.text: A genuinely fun, low-key way to explore, tracking down all six of the old town's baroque fountains.
thingsToDo.tip: Genuinely pick up a map from the tourist information office to help find them all.

thingsToDo.title: Tour the Archbishop's Palace

image.alt: The throne room of the Archbishop's Palace in Olomouc

thingsToDo.text: A genuinely grand interior, including a throne room used for significant moments in Habsburg history.
thingsToDo.tip: Genuinely check opening hours ahead, as tours don't run daily.

thingsToDo.title: Wander between the Upper and Lower Squares

image.alt: Wandering Olomouc's historic squares

thingsToDo.text: A genuinely relaxed way to spend an afternoon, taking in the old town's baroque architecture at an easy pace.
thingsToDo.tip: Genuinely stop at a café along the way — Olomouc's student population keeps the scene lively.

image.alt: Olomoucké tvarůžky, Olomouc's distinctive local cheese

foods.text: Genuinely a local speciality found nowhere else in the world, a pungent, low-fat curd cheese with a devoted following.
foods.whereToTry: Restaurants and specialty shops throughout the old town.

foods.name: Svíčková (marinated beef in cream sauce)

image.alt: Svíčková, marinated beef in cream sauce with bread dumplings

foods.text: Genuinely a reliable classic, found at traditional restaurants throughout the city.
foods.whereToTry: Traditional restaurants around the Upper and Lower Squares.

foods.name: Guláš with dumplings

image.alt: Czech goulash served with bread dumplings

foods.text: Genuinely a warming, filling classic, common on menus throughout the old town.

foods.name: Smažený sýr (fried cheese)

image.alt: Smažený sýr, breaded fried cheese with tartar sauce and potatoes

foods.text: Genuinely a satisfying pub classic, a good contrast to the sharper flavour of tvarůžky.

foods.name: Czech beer (pivo)

image.alt: A glass of Czech pilsner beer

foods.text: Genuinely a natural pairing with tvarůžky, which is traditionally eaten with beer and bread.
foods.whereToTry: Pubs and cafés throughout the old town.

foods.name: Koláče (fruit-filled pastries)

foods.text: Genuinely a nice sweet stop, found at bakeries and cafés across the old town.
foods.whereToTry: Bakeries around the Upper and Lower Squares.
